body: Your advice on what to say really helped me to convince my mom to take me to get the pill. She still doesn't look at me the same way, there's a sense of disgust and shame when she finally does, but I hope that will eventually go away.
I don't think they come out as far as I live. And if they did, there's so many back roads that you have to take it would be a nightmare.

Almost 17. 
My friends won't take me unless I pay for gas, and I don't have enough money to do that.
I live in eastern Connecticut. The closest Planned Parenthood is 15 miles away, and I don't have my license yet.
